description: Mutation sweep over the liquidity-capacity gate. B19C_CAPACITY_WALL_SIZE_DEPENDENCE_V1 -- frozen and committed alone -- states it INHERITS B15M's monotonicity verification and its differential test against B10b. That inheritance is only worth something if the inherited guards are load-bearing, and B10b's own maximality proof turned out not to be.

expected_survivors_note: None expected. assert_maximal is already EXTRACTED as a named function precisely so its post-conditions can be provoked -- its docstring cites B10b learning that lesson the expensive way -- so if those two survive, extraction was necessary and not sufficient.
pytest_args_reason: ONE test of the 57 is excluded: it opens research/b15o/replication.json, research/b10b_observed_paths.sqlite and research/b15i/processed_feed.sqlite, which are untracked and therefore absent from a staged tree by design -- that absence is what keeps a staged tree from reaching the live research/b11a while a watcher writes to it. Without the exclusion the baseline fails and the sweep refuses, which is correct but leaves the other 56 tests unswept. WHAT THIS COSTS: any guard reachable ONLY through that test is invisible here, so a mutant killed solely by it will report as a survivor and must be given its own test rather than declared. That is the safe direction, but it is a real narrowing and this sweep's number is about 56 tests, not 57.
